newsitem.title: USA: Guilford County, N.C., mulls school bond vote.
newsitem.headline: Guilford County, N.C., mulls school bond vote.

text.p: The chairman of North Carolina's Guilford County Commission has endorsed a proposed school bond referendum of $350 million to $400 million, the News & Record reported Friday.

Commissioner Joe Bostic said he would ask the 11-member commission to put the referendum on the ballot in the fall of 1998. Two other commissioners previously expressed support for the proposal, the newspaper said.
More than 5,000 of the county school system's 59,000 students attend classes in 311 trailers parked beside its 94 schools.

Despite the crowding, voters rejected a $198 million school bond proposal in 1994. But 70 percent of Guildford County voters approved the $1.8 billion statewide school bond proposal that will give the county about $57.2 million for construction.
